title: For How Much Would You Become a Flower? ‘Fool Night’ Main Trailer and Key Art Unveiled
summary: For how much would you become a flower? In their first collaboration, SUNRISE and SHAFT present a human drama set in a dystopian future that reflects our modern times.
body_markdown:
###


For how much would you become a flower?


The upcoming Netflix series


Fool Night


is an ambitious project marking the first-ever collaboration between two of Japan’s leading anime studios: SUNRISE, globally renowned for years for legendary franchises like


Cowboy Bebop


and the


Gundam


series (including Mobile Suit Gundam


THE WITCH FROM MERCURY


), and


SHAFT,


which has captivated anime fans worldwide with its unique visual style in masterpieces like Puella Magi Madoka Magica and the Monogatari series. Now, the main trailer and key art symbolizing the world of


Fool Night


— a beautiful yet cruel dystopian human drama — have officially been revealed. The main trailer and key art symbolizing the world of


Fool Night


— a beautiful yet cruel dystopian human drama — have officially been revealed. Along with this, the opening theme has been decided as “Shake! spit out” by Tempalay, and the ending theme as “iki” by Nowlu.


In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky and most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away, humanity faces a serious oxygen shortage. A new technology called Transfloration is used to implant seeds in the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants that will provide a meager amount of oxygen to help prolong the survival of a world without light.


Toshiro Kamiya, a poor young man whose harsh upbringing robbed him of all hope in life, decides he wants to undergo Transfloration and visits Transflora Medical, where he runs into his childhood friend Yomiko Horai, who is a worker there. After undergoing the procedure, Toshiro gains the special ability to hear the voices of "Spiriflora" — humans who have been turned into plants via Transfloration.


Transflora Medical hires him as a Special Temporary Worker, seeking to make use of this ability.


Meanwhile, a series of murders is committed by a Spiriflor. Toshiro is assigned to help with the investigation, but as the Spiriflor’s voice leads him closer to the truth, the case morphs into something much deeper and more complex than anyone bargained for.
